AX-WITNESS-REPDIST.statement: ∀ (C : ContextUniverse) (r : Rel_C(C)) (d : Dist_C(C)) (w : TYPE_WITNESS_C(C,r,d)) (x_d : Expr_D(C)), TypedWitness_C(C, w, x_d) → RepDist_C(C, x_d)
guards: Must bind the same context C
w must be a well-typed witness of TYPE_WITNESS_C(C, r, d)
x_d must be a valid target distinction expression Expr_D(C)
prohibited_strengthenings: RepDist_C(C, x_d) → ∃ w, TypedWitness_C(C, w, x_d)
Axiom does not imply witness preservation across transition

AX-REALIZATION-WITNESS.statement: ∀ (C : ContextUniverse) (r : Rel_C(C)) (d : Dist_C(C)) (x_r : Realization_C(C)) (x_d : Expr_D(C)) (w : TYPE_WITNESS_C(C,r,d)), project_w(C, r, d, x_r, x_d) = Some(w) → TypedWitness_C(C, w, x_d)
guards: Must bind the same context C
Realization x_r must match target relation r and distinction compatibility d for semantic target x_d
prohibited_strengthenings: Every realization determines a unique witness
